import ../raw/ndk/aaudio
import ../../core
import std/[options, strformat]

type
  AudioError* = object of AndroidError
    aaudioResult*: aaudio_result_t

  SafeAAudioStream* = ref object
    stream: ptr AAudioStream
    builder: ptr AAudioStreamBuilder
    isOpen: bool
    sampleRate: int32
    channelCount: int32
    direction: aaudio_direction_t

proc aaudioResultToString(result: aaudio_result_t): string =
  ## Convert AAudio result code to human-readable string
  # Implementation: Map AAudio error codes to descriptive strings
  case result
  of AAUDIO_OK: "Success"
  of AAUDIO_ERROR_DISCONNECTED: "Device disconnected"
  of AAUDIO_ERROR_ILLEGAL_ARGUMENT: "Illegal argument"
  of AAUDIO_ERROR_INCOMPATIBLE: "Incompatible configuration"
  of AAUDIO_ERROR_INTERNAL: "Internal error"
  of AAUDIO_ERROR_INVALID_STATE: "Invalid state"
  of AAUDIO_ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE: "Invalid handle"
  of AAUDIO_ERROR_UNIMPLEMENTED: "Unimplemented feature"
  of AAUDIO_ERROR_UNAVAILABLE: "Service unavailable"
  of AAUDIO_ERROR_NO_FREE_HANDLES: "No free handles"
  of AAUDIO_ERROR_NO_MEMORY: "Out of memory"
  of AAUDIO_ERROR_NULL_POINTER: "Null pointer"
  of AAUDIO_ERROR_TIMEOUT: "Operation timeout"
  of AAUDIO_ERROR_WOULD_BLOCK: "Would block"
  of AAUDIO_ERROR_INVALID_FORMAT: "Invalid format"
  of AAUDIO_ERROR_OUT_OF_RANGE: "Value out of range"
  of AAUDIO_ERROR_NO_SERVICE: "Service not available"
  of AAUDIO_ERROR_INVALID_RATE: "Invalid sample rate"
  else: &"Unknown error ({result})"

proc createAAudioStream*(
  direction: aaudio_direction_t = AAUDIO_DIRECTION_OUTPUT,
  sampleRate: int32 = 44100,
  channelCount: int32 = 2,
  format: aaudio_format_t = AAUDIO_FORMAT_PCM_I16,
  performanceMode: aaudio_performance_mode_t = AAUDIO_PERFORMANCE_MODE_LOW_LATENCY
): Result[SafeAAudioStream, AudioError] =
  ## Create AAudio stream with comprehensive error handling and validation
  # Implementation: Check API level, validate parameters, create builder, configure, open stream
  
  # Check API level first
  if getApiLevel() < 26:
    return err(AudioError(
      kind: aekApiTooOld, 
      msg: "AAudio requires Android API level 26 or higher"
    ))

  # Validate parameters
  if sampleRate <= 0 or sampleRate > 192000:
    return err(AudioError(
      kind: aekInvalidParam,
      msg: &"Invalid sample rate: {sampleRate}. Must be between 1 and 192000"
    ))

  if channelCount <= 0 or channelCount > 8:
    return err(AudioError(
      kind: aekInvalidParam,
      msg: &"Invalid channel count: {channelCount}. Must be between 1 and 8"
    ))

  # Create builder
  let builder = AAudioStreamBuilder_new()
  if builder == nil:
    return err(AudioError(
      kind: aekInitFailed,
      msg: "Failed to create AAudio stream builder"
    ))

  # Configure builder with error checking
  var result_code: aaudio_result_t

  result_code = AAudioStreamBuilder_setDirection(builder, direction)
  if result_code != AAUDIO_OK:
    AAudioStreamBuilder_delete(builder)
    return err(AudioError(
      kind: aekRuntimeError,
      msg: &"Failed to set direction: {aaudioResultToString(result_code)}",
      aaudioResult: result_code
    ))

  result_code = AAudioStreamBuilder_setSampleRate(builder, sampleRate)
  if result_code != AAUDIO_OK:
    AAudioStreamBuilder_delete(builder)
    return err(AudioError(
      kind: aekRuntimeError,
      msg: &"Failed to set sample rate: {aaudioResultToString(result_code)}",
      aaudioResult: result_code
    ))

  result_code = AAudioStreamBuilder_setChannelCount(builder, channelCount)
  if result_code != AAUDIO_OK:
    AAudioStreamBuilder_delete(builder)
    return err(AudioError(
      kind: aekRuntimeError,
      msg: &"Failed to set channel count: {aaudioResultToString(result_code)}",
      aaudioResult: result_code
    ))

  result_code = AAudioStreamBuilder_setFormat(builder, format)
  if result_code != AAUDIO_OK:
    AAudioStreamBuilder_delete(builder)
    return err(AudioError(
      kind: aekRuntimeError,
      msg: &"Failed to set format: {aaudioResultToString(result_code)}",
      aaudioResult: result_code
    ))

  result_code = AAudioStreamBuilder_setPerformanceMode(builder, performanceMode)
  if result_code != AAUDIO_OK:
    AAudioStreamBuilder_delete(builder)
    return err(AudioError(
      kind: aekRuntimeError,
      msg: &"Failed to set performance mode: {aaudioResultToString(result_code)}",
      aaudioResult: result_code
    ))

  # Open stream
  var stream: ptr AAudioStream
  result_code = AAudioStreamBuilder_openStream(builder, stream.addr)
  if result_code != AAUDIO_OK:
    AAudioStreamBuilder_delete(builder)
    return err(AudioError(
      kind: aekRuntimeError,
      msg: &"Failed to open AAudio stream: {aaudioResultToString(result_code)}",
      aaudioResult: result_code
    ))

  # Success - create safe wrapper
  ok(SafeAAudioStream(
    stream: stream,
    builder: builder,
    isOpen: true,
    sampleRate: sampleRate,
    channelCount: channelCount,
    direction: direction
  ))

proc start*(safeStream: SafeAAudioStream): Result[void, AudioError] =
  ## Start audio stream playback/recording with error handling
  # Implementation: Validate stream state, call AAudioStream_requestStart, handle errors
  
  if not safeStream.isOpen:
    return err(AudioError(
      kind: aekNotInitialized,
      msg: "Stream is not open"
    ))

  let result = AAudioStream_requestStart(safeStream.stream)
  if result != AAUDIO_OK:
    return err(AudioError(
      kind: aekRuntimeError,
      msg: &"Failed to start stream: {aaudioResultToString(result)}",
      aaudioResult: result
    ))

  ok()

proc pause*(safeStream: SafeAAudioStream): Result[void, AudioError] =
  ## Pause audio stream with error handling
  # Implementation: Validate stream state, call AAudioStream_requestPause, handle errors
  
  if not safeStream.isOpen:
    return err(AudioError(
      kind: aekNotInitialized,
      msg: "Stream is not open"
    ))

  let result = AAudioStream_requestPause(safeStream.stream)
  if result != AAUDIO_OK:
    return err(AudioError(
      kind: aekRuntimeError,
      msg: &"Failed to pause stream: {aaudioResultToString(result)}",
      aaudioResult: result
    ))

  ok()

proc stop*(safeStream: SafeAAudioStream): Result[void, AudioError] =
  ## Stop audio stream with error handling
  # Implementation: Validate stream state, call AAudioStream_requestStop, handle errors
  
  if not safeStream.isOpen:
    return err(AudioError(
      kind: aekNotInitialized,
      msg: "Stream is not open"
    ))

  let result = AAudioStream_requestStop(safeStream.stream)
  if result != AAUDIO_OK:
    return err(AudioError(
      kind: aekRuntimeError,
      msg: &"Failed to stop stream: {aaudioResultToString(result)}",
      aaudioResult: result
    ))

  ok()

proc write*(safeStream: SafeAAudioStream, buffer: seq[byte], timeoutNs: int64 = 0): Result[int32, AudioError] =
  ## Write audio data to output stream with comprehensive error handling
  # Implementation: Validate parameters, calculate frame count, call AAudioStream_write, handle partial writes
  
  if not safeStream.isOpen:
    return err(AudioError(
      kind: aekNotInitialized,
      msg: "Stream is not open"
    ))

  if safeStream.direction != AAUDIO_DIRECTION_OUTPUT:
    return err(AudioError(
      kind: aekInvalidParam,
      msg: "Cannot write to input stream"
    ))

  if buffer.len == 0:
    return ok(0'i32)

  # Calculate frame count (assuming 16-bit samples)
  let bytesPerFrame = safeStream.channelCount * 2  # 2 bytes per 16-bit sample
  let frameCount = buffer.len div bytesPerFrame

  if frameCount == 0:
    return err(AudioError(
      kind: aekInvalidParam,
      msg: &"Buffer too small: {buffer.len} bytes, need at least {bytesPerFrame} bytes per frame"
    ))

  let framesWritten = AAudioStream_write(
    safeStream.stream,
    buffer[0].unsafeAddr,
    frameCount.int32,
    timeoutNs
  )

  if framesWritten < 0:
    return err(AudioError(
      kind: aekRuntimeError,
      msg: &"Write failed: {aaudioResultToString(framesWritten)}",
      aaudioResult: framesWritten
    ))

  ok(framesWritten)

proc read*(safeStream: SafeAAudioStream, buffer: var seq[byte], timeoutNs: int64 = 0): Result[int32, AudioError] =
  ## Read audio data from input stream with comprehensive error handling
  # Implementation: Validate parameters, calculate frame count, call AAudioStream_read, handle partial reads
  
  if not safeStream.isOpen:
    return err(AudioError(
      kind: aekNotInitialized,
      msg: "Stream is not open"
    ))

  if safeStream.direction != AAUDIO_DIRECTION_INPUT:
    return err(AudioError(
      kind: aekInvalidParam,
      msg: "Cannot read from output stream"
    ))

  if buffer.len == 0:
    return ok(0'i32)

  # Calculate frame count
  let bytesPerFrame = safeStream.channelCount * 2
  let frameCount = buffer.len div bytesPerFrame

  if frameCount == 0:
    return err(AudioError(
      kind: aekInvalidParam,
      msg: &"Buffer too small: {buffer.len} bytes, need at least {bytesPerFrame} bytes per frame"
    ))

  let framesRead = AAudioStream_read(
    safeStream.stream,
    buffer[0].addr,
    frameCount.int32,
    timeoutNs
  )

  if framesRead < 0:
    return err(AudioError(
      kind: aekRuntimeError,
      msg: &"Read failed: {aaudioResultToString(framesRead)}",
      aaudioResult: framesRead
    ))

  ok(framesRead)

proc getLatency*(safeStream: SafeAAudioStream): Result[float32, AudioError] =
  ## Get stream latency in milliseconds
  # Implementation: Get frames per burst, calculate latency based on sample rate and burst size
  
  if not safeStream.isOpen:
    return err(AudioError(
      kind: aekNotInitialized,
      msg: "Stream is not open"
    ))

  let framesPerBurst = AAudioStream_getFramesPerBurst(safeStream.stream)
  if framesPerBurst <= 0:
    return err(AudioError(
      kind: aekRuntimeError,
      msg: "Failed to get frames per burst"
    ))

  let actualSampleRate = AAudioStream_getSampleRate(safeStream.stream)
  if actualSampleRate <= 0:
    return err(AudioError(
      kind: aekRuntimeError,
      msg: "Failed to get sample rate"
    ))

  # Calculate latency: (frames per burst / sample rate) * 1000 ms
  let latencyMs = (framesPerBurst.float32 / actualSampleRate.float32) * 1000.0
  ok(latencyMs)

proc close*(safeStream: SafeAAudioStream) =
  ## Close stream and clean up resources
  # Implementation: Close stream if open, delete builder, mark as closed
  
  if safeStream.isOpen:
    if safeStream.stream != nil:
      discard AAudioStream_close(safeStream.stream)
      safeStream.stream = nil
    
    if safeStream.builder != nil:
      AAudioStreamBuilder_delete(safeStream.builder)
      safeStream.builder = nil
    
    safeStream.isOpen = false

## LAYER 2: Safe SDK Wrappers (android/safe/sdk/audio.nim)
## ============================================================================

import ../raw/sdk/audio
import ../../core
import std/[options, strformat]

type
  SafeAudioManager* = ref object
    javaManager: AudioManager
    context: AndroidContext

  SafeAudioTrack* = ref object
    javaTrack: AudioTrack
    isInitialized: bool
    sampleRate: int32
    channelCount: int32
    bufferSize: int32

proc createAudioManager*(context: AndroidContext): Result[SafeAudioManager, AudioError] =
  ## Create safe AudioManager wrapper with JNI error handling
  # Implementation: Validate JNI context, get system service, wrap in safe object
  
  if context.jniEnv == nil:
    return err(AudioError(
      kind: aekNoContext,
      msg: "JNI environment is null"
    ))

  if context.javaContext == nil:
    return err(AudioError(
      kind: aekNoContext,
      msg: "Java context is null"
    ))

  try:
    # Get AudioManager system service through JNI
    let serviceObj = context.javaContext.getSystemService("audio".toJString)
    if serviceObj == nil:
      return err(AudioError(
        kind: aekJniError,
        msg: "Failed to get AudioManager service"
      ))

    let audioManager = serviceObj.AudioManager
    ok(SafeAudioManager(
      javaManager: audioManager,
      context: context
    ))
  except:
    err(AudioError(
      kind: aekJniError,
      msg: &"JNI error creating AudioManager: {getCurrentExceptionMsg()}"
    ))

proc createAudioTrack*(
  manager: SafeAudioManager,
  sampleRate: int32 = 44100,
  channelCount: int32 = 2,
  bufferSizeBytes: int32 = 8192
): Result[SafeAudioTrack, AudioError] =
  ## Create safe AudioTrack with validation and error handling
  # Implementation: Validate parameters, calculate buffer size, create AudioTrack via JNI
  
  if sampleRate <= 0 or sampleRate > 192000:
    return err(AudioError(
      kind: aekInvalidParam,
      msg: &"Invalid sample rate: {sampleRate}"
    ))

  if channelCount <= 0 or channelCount > 8:
    return err(AudioError(
      kind: aekInvalidParam,
      msg: &"Invalid channel count: {channelCount}"
    ))

  try:
    let channelConfig = if channelCount == 1: CHANNEL_OUT_MONO else: CHANNEL_OUT_STEREO
    
    let audioTrack = AudioTrack.new(
      STREAM_MUSIC,
      sampleRate,
      channelConfig,
      ENCODING_PCM_16BIT,
      bufferSizeBytes,
      MODE_STREAM
    )

    if audioTrack == nil:
      return err(AudioError(
        kind: aekInitFailed,
        msg: "Failed to create AudioTrack"
      ))

    ok(SafeAudioTrack(
      javaTrack: audioTrack,
      isInitialized: true,
      sampleRate: sampleRate,
      channelCount: channelCount,
      bufferSize: bufferSizeBytes
    ))
  except:
    err(AudioError(
      kind: aekJniError,
      msg: &"JNI error creating AudioTrack: {getCurrentExceptionMsg()}"
    ))

proc play*(track: SafeAudioTrack): Result[void, AudioError] =
  ## Start AudioTrack playback with error handling
  # Implementation: Validate track state, call play() via JNI, handle exceptions
  
  if not track.isInitialized:
    return err(AudioError(
      kind: aekNotInitialized,
      msg: "AudioTrack not initialized"
    ))

  try:
    track.javaTrack.play()
    ok()
  except:
    err(AudioError(
      kind: aekJniError,
      msg: &"Failed to start playback: {getCurrentExceptionMsg()}"
    ))

proc pause*(track: SafeAudioTrack): Result[void, AudioError] =
  ## Pause AudioTrack playback with error handling
  # Implementation: Validate track state, call pause() via JNI, handle exceptions
  
  if not track.isInitialized:
    return err(AudioError(
      kind: aekNotInitialized,
      msg: "AudioTrack not initialized"
    ))

  try:
    track.javaTrack.pause()
    ok()
  except:
    err(AudioError(
      kind: aekJniError,
      msg: &"Failed to pause playback: {getCurrentExceptionMsg()}"
    ))

proc stop*(track: SafeAudioTrack): Result[void, AudioError] =
  ## Stop AudioTrack playback with error handling
  # Implementation: Validate track state, call stop() via JNI, handle exceptions
  
  if not track.isInitialized:
    return err(AudioError(
      kind: aekNotInitialized,
      msg: "AudioTrack not initialized"
    ))

  try:
    track.javaTrack.stop()
    ok()
  except:
    err(AudioError(
      kind: aekJniError,
      msg: &"Failed to stop playback: {getCurrentExceptionMsg()}"
    ))

proc write*(track: SafeAudioTrack, buffer: seq[int16]): Result[int32, AudioError] =
  ## Write audio data to AudioTrack with error handling
  # Implementation: Validate parameters, convert to Java array, call write() via JNI
  
  if not track.isInitialized:
    return err(AudioError(
      kind: aekNotInitialized,
      msg: "AudioTrack not initialized"
    ))

  if buffer.len == 0:
    return ok(0'i32)

  try:
    # Convert Nim seq to Java short array
    let javaArray = newJShortArray(buffer.len)
    for i, sample in buffer:
      javaArray[i] = sample.jshort

    let bytesWritten = track.javaTrack.write(javaArray, 0, buffer.len.jint)
    ok(bytesWritten)
  except:
    err(AudioError(
      kind: aekJniError,
      msg: &"Failed to write audio data: {getCurrentExceptionMsg()}"
    ))

proc setVolume*(track: SafeAudioTrack, volume: float32): Result[void, AudioError] =
  ## Set AudioTrack volume with validation
  # Implementation: Validate volume range, call setVolume() via JNI
  
  if not track.isInitialized:
    return err(AudioError(
      kind: aekNotInitialized,
      msg: "AudioTrack not initialized"
    ))

  if volume < 0.0 or volume > 1.0:
    return err(AudioError(
      kind: aekInvalidParam,
      msg: &"Volume must be between 0.0 and 1.0, got {volume}"
    ))

  try:
    let result = track.javaTrack.setVolume(volume)
    if result != 0:
      return err(AudioError(
        kind: aekRuntimeError,
        msg: &"Failed to set volume: error code {result}"
      ))
    ok()
  except:
    err(AudioError(
      kind: aekJniError,
      msg: &"Failed to set volume: {getCurrentExceptionMsg()}"
    ))

proc release*(track: SafeAudioTrack) =
  ## Release AudioTrack resources
  # Implementation: Call release() via JNI, mark as uninitialized, handle exceptions gracefully
  
  if track.isInitialized:
    try:
      track.javaTrack.release()
    except:
      # Log error but don't throw - we're cleaning up
      echo "Warning: Error releasing AudioTrack: ", getCurrentExceptionMsg()
    finally:
      track.isInitialized = false

## ============================================================================
## LAYER 3: Idiomatic NDK API (android/idiomatic/ndk/audio.nim)
## ============================================================================

import ../../safe/ndk/audio
import ../../core
import std/[asyncdispatch, options, sequtils]

type
  NdkAudioManager* = ref object
    runtime: AndroidRuntime
    activeStreams: seq[AAudioEngine]

  AAudioEngine* = ref object
    safeStream: SafeAAudioStream
    isPlaying: bool
    sampleRate: int32
    channelCount: int32
    volume: float32
    direction: aaudio_direction_t

  AudioBuffer* = object
    data*: seq[int16]
    sampleRate*: int32
    channelCount*: int32

proc newNdkAudioManager*(runtime: AndroidRuntime): NdkAudioManager =
  ## Create NDK audio manager with runtime context
  # Implementation: Initialize manager with runtime reference, empty stream list
  NdkAudioManager(
    runtime: runtime,
    activeStreams: @[]
  )

proc createOutputEngine*(
  manager: NdkAudioManager,
  sampleRate: int32 = 44100,
  channelCount: int32 = 2,
  lowLatency: bool = true
): AAudioEngine =
  ## Create AAudio output engine with Nim-style error handling
  # Implementation: Create safe stream, wrap in engine, add to manager, handle errors with exceptions
  
  let performanceMode = if lowLatency: 
    AAUDIO_PERFORMANCE_MODE_LOW_LATENCY 
  else: 
    AAUDIO_PERFORMANCE_MODE_NONE

  let streamResult = createAAudioStream(
    direction = AAUDIO_DIRECTION_OUTPUT,
    sampleRate = sampleRate,
    channelCount = channelCount,
    format = AAUDIO_FORMAT_PCM_I16,
    performanceMode = performanceMode
  )

  case streamResult
  of ok(safeStream):
    let engine = AAudioEngine(
      safeStream: safeStream,
      isPlaying: false,
      sampleRate: sampleRate,
      channelCount: channelCount,
      volume: 1.0,
      direction: AAUDIO_DIRECTION_OUTPUT
    )
    manager.activeStreams.add(engine)
    return engine
  
  of err(error):
    raise newException(AudioError, error.msg)

proc createInputEngine*(
  manager: NdkAudioManager,
  sampleRate: int32 = 44100,
  channelCount: int32 = 1
): AAudioEngine =
  ## Create AAudio input engine for recording
  # Implementation: Create input stream, wrap in engine, add to manager
  
  let streamResult = createAAudioStream(
    direction = AAUDIO_DIRECTION_INPUT,
    sampleRate = sampleRate,
    channelCount = channelCount,
    format = AAUDIO_FORMAT_PCM_I16,
    performanceMode = AAUDIO_PERFORMANCE_MODE_LOW_LATENCY
  )

  case streamResult
  of ok(safeStream):
    let engine = AAudioEngine(
      safeStream: safeStream,
      isPlaying: false,
      sampleRate: sampleRate,
      channelCount: channelCount,
      volume: 1.0,
      direction: AAUDIO_DIRECTION_INPUT
    )
    manager.activeStreams.add(engine)
    return engine
  
  of err(error):
    raise newException(AudioError, error.msg)

proc play*(engine: AAudioEngine) =
  ## Start audio playback with Nim-style error handling
  # Implementation: Start stream if not playing, handle errors with exceptions
  
  if not engine.isPlaying:
    let result = engine.safeStream.start()
    case result
    of ok():
      engine.isPlaying = true
    of err(error):
      raise newException(AudioError, error.msg)

proc pause*(engine: AAudioEngine) =
  ## Pause audio playback
  # Implementation: Pause stream, update state, handle errors with exceptions
  
  if engine.isPlaying:
    let result = engine.safeStream.pause()
    case result
    of ok():
      engine.isPlaying = false
    of err(error):
      raise newException(AudioError, error.msg)

proc stop*(engine: AAudioEngine) =
  ## Stop audio playback
  # Implementation: Stop stream, update state, handle errors with exceptions
  
  if engine.isPlaying:
    let result = engine.safeStream.stop()
    case result
    of ok():
      engine.isPlaying = false
    of err(error):
      raise newException(AudioError, error.msg)

proc write*(engine: AAudioEngine, buffer: AudioBuffer) =
  ## Write audio buffer to output stream with automatic volume adjustment
  # Implementation: Validate direction, apply volume, convert to bytes, write to stream
  
  if engine.direction != AAUDIO_DIRECTION_OUTPUT:
    raise newException(AudioError, "Cannot write to input engine")

  if buffer.data.len == 0:
    return

  # Apply volume if not 1.0
  var processedData = buffer.data
  if engine.volume != 1.0:
    processedData = buffer.data.mapIt((it.float32 * engine.volume).int16)

  # Convert to byte array
  let byteData = cast[seq[byte]](processedData)
  
  let result = engine.safeStream.write(byteData)
  case result
  of ok(framesWritten):
    discard # Success
  of err(error):
    raise newException(AudioError, error.msg)

proc read*(engine: AAudioEngine, frameCount: int32): AudioBuffer =
  ## Read audio data from input stream
  # Implementation: Validate direction, allocate buffer, read from stream, convert to AudioBuffer
  
  if engine.direction != AAUDIO_DIRECTION_INPUT:
    raise newException(AudioError, "Cannot read from output engine")

  let bytesPerFrame = engine.channelCount * 2  # 16-bit samples
  let bufferSize = frameCount * bytesPerFrame
  var byteBuffer = newSeq[byte](bufferSize)

  let result = engine.safeStream.read(byteBuffer)
  case result
  of ok(framesRead):
    let actualBytes = framesRead * bytesPerFrame
    byteBuffer.setLen(actualBytes)
    
    # Convert bytes back to int16 samples
    let sampleData = cast[seq[int16]](byteBuffer)
    
    return AudioBuffer(
      data: sampleData,
      sampleRate: engine.sampleRate,
      channelCount: engine.channelCount
    )
  
  of err(error):
    raise newException(AudioError, error.msg)

proc setVolume*(engine: AAudioEngine, volume: float32) =
  ## Set playback volume (0.0 to 1.0)
  # Implementation: Validate range, store volume for future use in write()
  
  if volume < 0.0 or volume > 1.0:
    raise newException(AudioError, "Volume must be between 0.0 and 1.0")
  
  engine.volume = volume

proc getVolume*(engine: AAudioEngine): float32 =
  ## Get current playback volume
  # Implementation: Return stored volume value
  engine.volume

proc getLatency*(engine: AAudioEngine): float32 =
  ## Get audio latency in milliseconds
  # Implementation: Call safe stream getLatency, handle errors
  
  let result = engine.safeStream.getLatency()
  case result
  of ok(latency): latency
  of err(error): raise newException(AudioError, error.msg)

proc isPlaying*(engine: AAudioEngine): bool =
  ## Check if audio is playing
  # Implementation: Return playing state
  engine.isPlaying

proc getSampleRate*(engine: AAudioEngine): int32 =
  ## Get engine sample rate
  # Implementation: Return stored sample rate
  engine.sampleRate

proc getChannelCount*(engine: AAudioEngine): int32 =
  ## Get engine channel count
  # Implementation: Return stored channel count
  engine.channelCount

proc close*(engine: AAudioEngine) =
  ## Close audio engine and free resources
  # Implementation: Stop if playing, close safe stream, clean up
  
  if engine.isPlaying:
    engine.stop()
  
  engine.safeStream.close()

proc close*(manager: NdkAudioManager) =
  ## Close all audio engines managed by this manager
  # Implementation: Iterate through active streams, close each one, clear list
  
  for engine in manager.activeStreams:
    engine.close()
  manager.activeStreams.setLen(0)

## LAYER 3: Idiomatic SDK API (android/idiomatic/sdk/audio.nim)

import ../../safe/sdk/audio
import ../../core
import std/[sequtils, math]

type
  SdkAudioManager* = ref object
    runtime: AndroidRuntime
    safeManager: SafeAudioManager
    activeTracks: seq[JavaAudioEngine]

  JavaAudioEngine* = ref object
    safeTrack: SafeAudioTrack
    isPlaying: bool
    volume: float32
    sampleRate: int32
    channelCount: int32

proc newSdkAudioManager*(runtime: AndroidRuntime): SdkAudioManager =
  ## Create SDK audio manager with Java context validation
  # Implementation: Validate runtime has context, create safe manager, handle errors
  
  if runtime.context.isNone:
    raise newException(AudioError, "SDK audio manager requires Java context")

  let managerResult = createAudioManager(runtime.context.get())
  case managerResult
  of ok(safeManager):
    SdkAudioManager(
      runtime: runtime,
      safeManager: safeManager,
      activeTracks: @[]
    )
  of err(error):
    raise newException(AudioError, error.msg)

proc createEngine*(
  manager: SdkAudioManager,
  sampleRate: int32 = 44100,
  channelCount: int32 = 2,
  bufferSize: int32 = 8192
): JavaAudioEngine =
  ## Create Java AudioTrack engine
  # Implementation: Create safe track, wrap in engine, add to manager
  
  let trackResult = manager.safeManager.createAudioTrack(
    sampleRate = sampleRate,
    channelCount = channelCount,
    bufferSizeBytes = bufferSize
  )

  case trackResult
  of ok(safeTrack):
    let engine = JavaAudioEngine(
      safeTrack: safeTrack,
      isPlaying: false,
      volume: 1.0,
      sampleRate: sampleRate,
      channelCount: channelCount
    )
    manager.activeTracks.add(engine)
    return engine
  
  of err(error):
    raise newException(AudioError, error.msg)

proc play*(engine: JavaAudioEngine) =
  ## Start AudioTrack playback
  # Implementation: Start track if not playing, handle errors
  
  if not engine.isPlaying:
    let result = engine.safeTrack.play()
    case result
    of ok():
      engine.isPlaying = true
    of err(error):
      raise newException(AudioError, error.msg)

proc pause*(engine: JavaAudioEngine) =
  ## Pause AudioTrack playback
  # Implementation: Pause track, update state
  
  if engine.isPlaying:
    let result = engine.safeTrack.pause()
    case result
    of ok():
      engine.isPlaying = false
    of err(error):
      raise newException(AudioError, error.msg)

proc stop*(engine: JavaAudioEngine) =
  ## Stop AudioTrack playback
  # Implementation: Stop track, update state
  
  if engine.isPlaying:
    let result = engine.safeTrack.stop()
    case result
    of ok():
      engine.isPlaying = false
    of err(error):
      raise newException(AudioError, error.msg)

proc write*(engine: JavaAudioEngine, buffer: AudioBuffer) =
  ## Write audio buffer to AudioTrack
  # Implementation: Apply volume, write to track, handle errors
  
  if buffer.data.len == 0:
    return

  # Apply volume
  var processedData = buffer.data
  if engine.volume != 1.0:
    processedData = buffer.data.mapIt((it.float32 * engine.volume).int16)

  let result = engine.safeTrack.write(processedData)
  case result
  of ok(bytesWritten):
    discard # Success
  of err(error):
    raise newException(AudioError, error.msg)

proc setVolume*(engine: JavaAudioEngine, volume: float32) =
  ## Set AudioTrack volume
  # Implementation: Validate range, set via safe track and store locally
  
  if volume < 0.0 or volume > 1.0:
    raise newException(AudioError, "Volume must be between 0.0 and 1.0")

  let result = engine.safeTrack.setVolume(volume)
  case result
  of ok():
    engine.volume = volume
  of err(error):
    raise newException(AudioError, error.msg)

proc getVolume*(engine: JavaAudioEngine): float32 =
  ## Get current volume
  # Implementation: Return stored volume
  engine.volume

proc isPlaying*(engine: JavaAudioEngine): bool =
  ## Check if playing
  # Implementation: Return playing state
  engine.isPlaying

proc getSampleRate*(engine: JavaAudioEngine): int32 =
  ## Get sample rate
  # Implementation: Return stored sample rate
  engine.sampleRate

proc getChannelCount*(engine: JavaAudioEngine): int32 =
  ## Get channel count
  # Implementation: Return stored channel count
  engine.channelCount

proc close*(engine: JavaAudioEngine) =
  ## Close AudioTrack engine
  # Implementation: Stop if playing, release track
  
  if engine.isPlaying:
    engine.stop()
  
  engine.safeTrack.release()

proc close*(manager: SdkAudioManager) =
  ## Close all AudioTrack engines
  # Implementation: Close all tracks, clear list
  
  for engine in manager.activeTracks:
    engine.close()
  manager.activeTracks.setLen(0)

## ============================================================================
## LAYER 4: Unified Smart API (android/audio.nim)
## ============================================================================

import idiomatic/ndk/audio as ndk_audio
import idiomatic/sdk/audio as sdk_audio
import core
import std/[asyncdispatch, options]

type
  # Unified audio engine - implementation selected at compile time!
  AudioEngine* = ref object
    runtime: AndroidRuntime
    case kind: AudioEngineKind
    when afAudio in usedFeatures or afLowLatencyAudio in usedFeatures:
      of aekNdk:
        ndkManager: NdkAudioManager
        ndkEngine: ndk_audio.AAudioEngine
      of aekSdk:
        sdkManager: SdkAudioManager  
        sdkEngine: JavaAudioEngine

  AudioEngineKind = enum
    aekNdk, aekSdk

  # Public types for the unified API
  AudioFormat* = enum
    afMono16 = "16-bit mono"
    afStereo16 = "16-bit stereo"

  AudioLatencyMode* = enum
    almStandard = "Standard latency"
    almLow = "Low latency"

  AudioEngineConfig* = object
    sampleRate*: int32
    format*: AudioFormat
    latencyMode*: AudioLatencyMode

# Global audio manager instance
var audioManager {.global.}: AudioEngine

proc initAudioManager*(runtime: AndroidRuntime): AudioEngine =
  ## Initialize optimal audio engine based on compile-time feature analysis and runtime capabilities
  # Implementation: Analyze used features, check runtime capabilities, create best engine
  
  new(result)
  result.runtime = runtime

  when afLowLatencyAudio in usedFeatures:
    # User specifically wants low latency - prefer NDK
    if runtime.apiLevel >= 26:
      echo "🎵 Initializing AAudio (low latency mode)"
      result.kind = aekNdk
      result.ndkManager = newNdkAudioManager(runtime)
      result.ndkEngine = result.ndkManager.createOutputEngine(lowLatency = true)
    elif runtime.context.isSome:
      echo "🎵 Initializing AudioTrack (fallback - AAudio not available)"
      result.kind = aekSdk
      result.sdkManager = newSdkAudioManager(runtime)
      result.sdkEngine = result.sdkManager.createEngine()
    else:
      raise newException(UnsupportedError, "Low latency audio not available")

  elif afAudio in usedFeatures:
    # Basic audio - choose based on runtime mode and capabilities
    case runtime.mode
    of armNdkOnly:
      if runtime.apiLevel >= 26:
        echo "🎵 Initializing AAudio (NDK-only mode)"
        result.kind = aekNdk
        result.ndkManager = newNdkAudioManager(runtime)
        result.ndkEngine = result.ndkManager.createOutputEngine(lowLatency = false)
      else:
        raise newException(UnsupportedError, "NDK audio requires API 26+")

    of armSdkOnly:
      if runtime.context.isSome:
        echo "🎵 Initializing AudioTrack (SDK-only mode)"
        result.kind = aekSdk
        result.sdkManager = newSdkAudioManager(runtime)
        result.sdkEngine = result.sdkManager.createEngine()
      else:
        raise newException(UnsupportedError, "SDK audio requires Java context")

    of armHybrid, armAuto:
      # Choose best available implementation
      if runtime.apiLevel >= 26:
        echo "🎵 Initializing AAudio (hybrid - best performance)"
        result.kind = aekNdk
        result.ndkManager = newNdkAudioManager(runtime)
        result.ndkEngine = result.ndkManager.createOutputEngine(lowLatency = false)
      elif runtime.context.isSome:
        echo "🎵 Initializing AudioTrack (hybrid - compatible)"
        result.kind = aekSdk
        result.sdkManager = newSdkAudioManager(runtime)
        result.sdkEngine = result.sdkManager.createEngine()
      else:
        raise newException(UnsupportedError, "No audio implementation available")

  else:
    # This should never happen if feature tracking works correctly
    raise newException(UnsupportedError, "Audio manager initialized but no audio features used")

proc getAudioManager*(): AudioEngine =
  ## Get the global audio manager instance
  # Implementation: Return global manager, validate it exists
  
  if audioManager == nil:
    raise newException(ValueError, "Audio manager not initialized")
  return audioManager

# Unified public API - automatically routes to optimal implementation
proc play*(buffer: AudioBuffer) =
  ## Play audio buffer using optimal implementation
  # Implementation: Track feature usage, get manager, route to correct engine
  
  trackFeature(afAudio)
  let manager = getAudioManager()
  
  when afAudio in usedFeatures or afLowLatencyAudio in usedFeatures:
    case manager.kind
    of aekNdk: manager.ndkEngine.write(buffer)
    of aekSdk: manager.sdkEngine.write(buffer)

proc playLowLatency*(buffer: AudioBuffer) =
  ## Play audio with low latency (uses AAudio if available)
  # Implementation: Track low latency feature, route to appropriate engine
  
  trackFeature(afLowLatencyAudio)
  let manager = getAudioManager()
  
  when afLowLatencyAudio in usedFeatures:
    case manager.kind
    of aekNdk: manager.ndkEngine.write(buffer)
    of aekSdk: manager.sdkEngine.write(buffer)  # Best effort with AudioTrack

proc startPlayback*() =
  ## Start audio playback
  # Implementation: Route to correct engine's play method
  
  let manager = getAudioManager()
  when afAudio in usedFeatures or afLowLatencyAudio in usedFeatures:
    case manager.kind
    of aekNdk: manager.ndkEngine.play()
    of aekSdk: manager.sdkEngine.play()

proc stopPlayback*() =
  ## Stop audio playback
  # Implementation: Route to correct engine's stop method
  
  let manager = getAudioManager()
  when afAudio in usedFeatures or afLowLatencyAudio in usedFeatures:
    case manager.kind
    of aekNdk: manager.ndkEngine.stop()
    of aekSdk: manager.sdkEngine.stop()

proc pausePlayback*() =
  ## Pause audio playback
  # Implementation: Route to correct engine's pause method
  
  let manager = getAudioManager()
  when afAudio in usedFeatures or afLowLatencyAudio in usedFeatures:
    case manager.kind
    of aekNdk: manager.ndkEngine.pause()
    of aekSdk: manager.sdkEngine.pause()

proc setVolume*(volume: float32) =
  ## Set audio volume (0.0 to 1.0)
  # Implementation: Route to correct engine's setVolume method
  
  let manager = getAudioManager()
  when afAudio in usedFeatures or afLowLatencyAudio in usedFeatures:
    case manager.kind
    of aekNdk: manager.ndkEngine.setVolume(volume)
    of aekSdk: manager.sdkEngine.setVolume(volume)

proc getVolume*(): float32 =
  ## Get current audio volume
  # Implementation: Route to correct engine's getVolume method
  
  let manager = getAudioManager()
  when afAudio in usedFeatures or afLowLatencyAudio in usedFeatures:
    case manager.kind
    of aekNdk: manager.ndkEngine.getVolume()
    of aekSdk: manager.sdkEngine.getVolume()
  else:
    1.0  # Default volume

proc getLatency*(): float32 =
  ## Get audio latency in milliseconds
  # Implementation: Route to correct engine, return appropriate latency
  
  let manager = getAudioManager()
  when afAudio in usedFeatures or afLowLatencyAudio in usedFeatures:
    case manager.kind
    of aekNdk: manager.ndkEngine.getLatency()
    of aekSdk: 50.0  # AudioTrack typical latency
  else:
    0.0

proc isPlaying*(): bool =
  ## Check if audio is currently playing
  # Implementation: Route to correct engine's isPlaying method
  
  let manager = getAudioManager()
  when afAudio in usedFeatures or afLowLatencyAudio in usedFeatures:
    case manager.kind
    of aekNdk: manager.ndkEngine.isPlaying()
    of aekSdk: manager.sdkEngine.isPlaying()
  else:
    false

proc getImplementationInfo*(): string =
  ## Get information about current audio implementation
  # Implementation: Return description of active engine
  
  let manager = getAudioManager()
  when afAudio in usedFeatures or afLowLatencyAudio in usedFeatures:
    case manager.kind
    of aekNdk: "AAudio (NDK) - Sample rate: " & $manager.ndkEngine.getSampleRate() & "Hz, Latency: " & $manager.ndkEngine.getLatency() & "ms"
    of aekSdk: "AudioTrack (SDK) - Sample rate: " & $manager.sdkEngine.getSampleRate() & "Hz, Standard latency"
  else:
    "No audio implementation"

# Convenience functions for common use cases
proc loadAudioFile*(filename: string): AudioBuffer =
  ## Load audio file into buffer (simplified implementation)
  # Implementation: Read file, decode audio format, return AudioBuffer
  # Note: Real implementation would use audio format libraries
  
  # Placeholder implementation - in real version would decode WAV/MP3/etc
  AudioBuffer(
    data: @[0'i16], # Empty buffer - real implementation would load file
    sampleRate: 44100,
    channelCount: 2
  )

proc playSound*(filename: string) =
  ## Quick play sound file
  # Implementation: Load audio file, play using unified API
  
  trackFeature(afAudio)
  let buffer = loadAudioFile(filename)
  startPlayback()
  play(buffer)

proc playSoundLowLatency*(filename: string) =
  ## Quick play sound with low latency
  # Implementation: Load audio file, play using low latency API
  
  trackFeature(afLowLatencyAudio)
  let buffer = loadAudioFile(filename)
  startPlayback()
  playLowLatency(buffer)

# Async versions
proc playAsync*(buffer: AudioBuffer): Future[void] {.async.} =
  ## Play audio buffer asynchronously
  # Implementation: Start playback, wait for completion
  
  startPlayback()
  play(buffer)
  # Note: Real implementation would wait for playback completion

proc playSoundAsync*(filename: string): Future[void] {.async.} =
  ## Quick async play sound file
  # Implementation: Load file, play asynchronously
  
  let buffer = loadAudioFile(filename)
  await playAsync(buffer)

# Audio engine management
proc closeAudioEngine*() =
  ## Close audio engine and free resources
  # Implementation: Close appropriate manager based on engine type
  
  if audioManager != nil:
    when afAudio in usedFeatures or afLowLatencyAudio in usedFeatures:
      case audioManager.kind
      of aekNdk: audioManager.ndkManager.close()
      of aekSdk: audioManager.sdkManager.close()
    
    audioManager = nil

## INTEGRATION WITH ANDROID RUNTIME (android/core.nim integration)
## ============================================================================

proc initializeAudioSubsystem*(runtime: AndroidRuntime) =
  ## Initialize audio subsystem - called automatically by Android runtime
  # Implementation: Only initialize if audio features are used
  
  when afAudio in usedFeatures or afLowLatencyAudio in usedFeatures:
    audioManager = initAudioManager(runtime)
    echo "✅ Audio subsystem initialized"
  else:
    echo "ℹ️ Audio subsystem not used - skipping initialization"

## USAGE EXAMPLES AND TESTS
## ============================================================================

when isMainModule:
  # Example 1: Basic audio playback
  proc basicAudioExample() =
    let buffer = AudioBuffer(
      data: @[1000'i16, -1000'i16, 1000'i16, -1000'i16], # Simple tone
      sampleRate: 44100,
      channelCount: 2
    )
    
    startPlayback()
    play(buffer)
    setVolume(0.8)
    
    echo "Implementation: ", getImplementationInfo()
    echo "Playing: ", isPlaying()
    echo "Volume: ", getVolume()
    echo "Latency: ", getLatency(), "ms"

  # Example 2: Low latency audio
  proc lowLatencyExample() =
    let buffer = AudioBuffer(
      data: @[2000'i16, -2000'i16] * 1000, # Longer tone
      sampleRate: 48000,
      channelCount: 2
    )
    
    startPlayback()
    playLowLatency(buffer)  # This will use AAudio if available
    
    echo "Low latency mode - Implementation: ", getImplementationInfo()

  # Example 3: Convenience functions
  proc convenienceExample() =
    playSound("beep.wav")  # Simple one-liner
    
    # Or with low latency
    playSoundLowLatency("click.wav")

  # The beauty: Same code works on all devices, optimal implementation selected automatically!
